The organisation

What the organisation says about itself and what is said about it: the Wikipedia page, its own pages (about, careers, apprenticeships, sites), the annual report or strategy page, news. Tier 2. Save pages as PDF with the date in the file name, because pages change and adverts vanish.

Name every file with its date and where it came from, for example 2026-09-17_careers-page_apprenticeships.pdf, and log it in Springpod_LEARN_Organisation_Knowledge_Base_V1.docx.
